input: Search the web for "youth enrichment" summer programs for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania and Polk counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.
searches: youth enrichment summer programs Hendersonville NC 2026
Roseland Community Center Tryon RISE official

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Henderson County
candidates.note: Summer day programming for children and teens; operated in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Runs Kanuga Day Camp, Camp Bob outreach programs and Camp Kanuga overnight programs.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight summer camp; 2026 sessions completed and 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Bound for Glory Camp
candidates.note: Free literacy and adventure camp for qualifying Transylvania youth ages 9–12; July 2026 day program with optional overnights.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Summer institutes for high-school musicians ages 14–18, plus shorter instrumental seminars.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Coed farm, wilderness and traditional summer camp; summer 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Roseland Community Center
candidates.note: Free RISE! summer enrichment for ages 6–13 ran June 15–July 1, 2026, with shorter Friday hours.

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: Runs SASY arts camps, PacJAM summer music camp and a theater camp with Tryon Little Theater.

candidates.name: Tryon Little Theater
candidates.note: Collaborated with Tryon Fine Arts Center on the July 27–31, 2026 theater camp and staged production.

candidates.name: Polk County Schools
candidates.note: Free one-week summer seminars for Advanced Learning/AIG students offered in June and July 2026.

candidates.name: Polk County Public Libraries
candidates.note: Summer Learning programming for children and teens ran June 8–August 2, 2026, at both libraries.
